claims.claim: Every A9 packing can be normalized into an 1188×839 subrectangle of A0.
claims.evidence: For fixed sheet orientations, the feasible coordinate set is compact: containment gives boundedness, while each pairwise nonoverlap condition is a finite union of closed separation inequalities. At a minimizer of the sum of all left and top coordinates, any sheet with positive left coordinate must have a vertically overlapping sheet whose right edge equals its left edge; otherwise a sufficiently small left translation decreases the objective. The analogous statement holds vertically. Following blockers strictly decreases the relevant coordinate and therefore reaches the boundary. Every right and bottom edge is consequently a nonnegative combination of 52 and 37. Exact enumeration gives maximum representable endpoints 1188 and 839; 1189, 840, and 841 are unrepresentable.
claims.witness: 1188=20·52+4·37 and 839=14·52+3·37. Exhaustive semigroup enumeration found no representation of 1189, 840, or 841.
claims.search_method: Direct compactness and blocker-chain proof, followed by exhaustive nonnegative-integer semigroup enumeration.

claims.claim: There is an explicit packing of 516 sheets.
claims.evidence: Expanding the three parameterized grids produces exactly 516 rectangles. Every rectangle has dimensions 52×37 or 37×52, every endpoint lies within 1188×839, and an exhaustive pairwise test confirms that no two interiors overlap.
claims.witness: The three grids contain respectively 20·3=60, 4·2=8, and 32·14=448 sheets, totaling 516. Their occupied regions are separated at x=1040 or y=111.
claims.search_method: Generated every specified rectangle and exhaustively checked dimensions, containment, and all rectangle pairs using exact integer comparisons.

claims.claim: No packing has 518 sheets; hence OPT≤517.
claims.evidence: Claim 0 reduces arbitrary real-coordinate packings to integer-coordinate packings. In any 52×37 placement, each of its 37 rows contains exactly one cell with x+y≡50 mod 52; the rotated orientation has exactly one such cell in each of its 37 columns. Thus every sheet has weight one when marked cells have weight 1/37. Exact residue-frequency counting over the reduced container gives 19,162 marked cells, whose total weight is 19,162/37=517+33/37<518. Nonoverlap therefore rules out 518 sheets.
claims.witness: The checker verifies all 52×52 starting-residue pairs for both orientations and obtains exactly 37 markers per sheet and 19,162 markers in the container.
claims.search_method: Exact modular residue enumeration and rational-arithmetic weight calculation.

claims.claim: Any hypothetical 517-packing must span a maximum reduced dimension and contain a prescribed blocking chain.
claims.evidence: For a normalized packing, 517·52·37=994,708 exceeds 1187·838=994,706. Hence its maximum right and bottom endpoints cannot both be at most 1187 and 838; one must equal 1188 or 839. A blocker chain reaching that endpoint has widths or heights summing to it. Exhaustive Diophantine enumeration shows the respective representations are unique.
claims.witness: The unique endpoint decompositions are 1188=20·52+4·37 and 839=14·52+3·37, yielding the stated orientation counts in the corresponding normalized blocker chain.
claims.search_method: Exact area comparison, blocker-chain analysis, and exhaustive enumeration of endpoint representations.

claims.claim: The natural horizontal 111+728 decomposition is exactly capped at 516.
claims.evidence: The 1188×111 part has area capacity 68, attained by the displayed 60+8 grids. Exhaustive line-pattern enumeration confirms max(5h+7v)=98 subject to 37h+52v≤728 and max(7h+5v)=160 subject to 52h+37v≤1188. Summing the two incidence inequalities gives 519N≤232,904<519·449, hence N≤448 in the lower part. A 32×14 grid of 37×52 sheets attains 448, so the split optimum is 68+448=516.
claims.search_method: Exhaustive integer enumeration of all feasible vertical and horizontal line patterns, followed by exact incidence arithmetic.

claims.claim: The maximum size of a guillotine (slicing) A9-in-A0 packing is 516.
claims.evidence: Bottom-up compaction preserves a slicing tree and makes every node dimension a member of ⟨37,52⟩: vertical nodes add widths and take the maximum height, while horizontal nodes do the converse. The reconstructed recurrence considered a leaf, predecessor slack in each dimension, every exact split into two positive representable widths, and every exact split into two positive representable heights. Structural induction gives both feasibility and completeness. There are 396×204 states including zero sentinels, and exact integer evaluation returns G(1188,839)=516. The displayed construction is slicing via cuts at y=111 and x=1040 followed by grid cuts.
claims.witness: The independently reconstructed dynamic program evaluated all semigroup states and returned slicing_optimum=516; its recurrence also dominates both uniform-grid candidates at every state.
claims.search_method: Independent reconstruction and exact evaluation of the complete two-direction slicing recurrence, with a structural-induction completeness check.

target_evidence: The draft rigorously establishes 516≤OPT≤517 and therefore eliminates the source target’s 518 alternative. It also proves necessary conditions for 517 and excludes all slicing packings and the fixed 111+728 architecture. It neither constructs a 517-packing nor excludes every nonslicing 517-packing, so it does not determine whether the exact optimum is 516 or 517. Its explicit claim of only PARTIAL resolution is accurate.
